title: docs(lint): os explain flow-condition-option-label covers filters and edge conditions
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuUCMp9Er3CdRqotD8tK5b8f)_

Fixes #37504 (item 2; item 1 landed in #37551).

## What changes

`os explain flow-condition-option-label` said the rule reads a record-change **start condition** only (`covers: 'why a start condition compares option values'`). Since #37491 the same rule id also fires on edge conditions, `decision` branch expressions, and the `filter` of `get_record` / `update_record` / `delete_record` and of a time-relative sweep. An author whose filter was refused read an explanation of a narrower rule than the one that fired.

`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` `FLOW_CONDITION_OPTION_LABEL_EXPLANATION` now:

- `covers`: `why flow conditions and filters use option values` (49 chars, the test's ≤60 bar).
- names every position the rule reads, and what the label costs there (the read finds nothing, the update / delete changes nothing, the branch is never taken, the run still reports success);
- conditions: the comparand shapes, the trigger record's `record.F` / `previous.F` / bare `F`, and a single-row `get_record` `outputVariable` row (`deal.F`); a variable bound elsewhere too is not judged;
- filters: implicit equality, `$eq` / `$ne`, `$in` / `$nin` members, under `$and` / `$or` / `$not`; not judged: related-object fields, ordering / text operators, braced strings (templates, `{current_user_id}`);
- the escape hatch for a deliberate label filter: a CEL value envelope `{ dialect: 'cel', source }`, which is not judged;
- the shared exclusions kept (label also a value, picklist-backed fields).

Every sentence is read off `validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts` (`FLOW_CONDITION_OPTION_LABEL` doc, `optionLabelsBeyondStart`) and `flow-select-options.ts` (`optionLabelOperands`) on main 10284387. No rule behaviour changes.

## Gates run

- `vitest run src/rule-explanations.test.ts src/flow-publish-checks-second-batch.test.ts` (packages/lint): 2 files, 58 tests passed.
- `tsc --noEmit -p packages/lint`: clean.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/lint` patch (explanation text only).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none


## Small calls this thread made

- Kept one rule id's explanation in one entry (five paragraphs) rather than splitting per position: `os explain` takes the rule id, and one id has one entry.
